  \caption{Performance of \nummodels model configurations on \numhumanscoredcommunities cultures with human evaluation, sorted by human-correct accuracy in descending order. \emph{Access} abbreviations are P (proprietary), OW (open-weight: weights, code, and a technical report released), and OS (open-source: additionally the training data and full training recipes). \emph{Parameters} are in billions: active/total for mixture-of-experts models, total for dense models, and ``--'' when undisclosed. \emph{Total} denotes \% of score 3 responses, \emph{exact} accuracy contributed by exact match, and \emph{review} by annotators and LLM judges. \emph{Reasoning} is the effort set in the request. \emph{Default} means that no effort was set, so the provider default applied, and N/A means that the model has no reasoning mode.
